speaker: Doctor

text: The presentation of erythematous patches with greasy yellow scales in a 3-month-old, particularly worsening in cold weather, is classic for infantile seborrheic dermatitis. I have sufficient clinical information to proceed. DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis
